title: eremosis pugana
intro: Eremosis pugana, commonly known as Mountain Eremosis, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The health benefits of Eremosis pugana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Eremosis pugana include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
